name: kerberos-guide-tools
description: Tests, lint and built-site checks for the Kerberos docs site. Not published; the site itself has no JavaScript dependencies.

scripts.html: node tools/require-site.js site && java -jar node_modules/vnu-jar/build/dist/vnu.jar --skip-non-html site
scripts.a11y: node tools/require-site.js site && node tools/check-a11y.js site
